motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: Can I keep what I pick up along the way, Commander?

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: As a mechanic, it's only natural that I always keep a spanner on my person...

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Crap... I lost some of my parts...

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Have a taste of my spanner!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: Hm... Can I not do this myself?

motions.name: login
motions.line: Is it not ready yet? Still not ready? This is killing me!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Crap... I lost some of my parts...

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: It's nice to stretch my legs outside the workshop every once in a while!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: A mechanism I've never seen before! Let me check it out!

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Is it not ready yet? Still not ready? This is killing me!

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: I-is this really okay? A Doll like me, who always reeks of machine oil...?  <>I'm not saying no, I just really wasn't expecting it. I'll accept it gladly, of course! It's you, after all!  <>Then... I'll be in your care? I'll keep doing my best and make you more interesting tools!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: You're too fragile, Commander... I must build a machine that can give you proper protection... Don't worry, I won't make any modifications to your body. There are a lot of technological hurdles to overcome, but I won't give up!
